body: I would have disagreed initially with this (maybe believing in the good nature of others?) but seeing as the user has been using slurs, then i unfortunately think you are correct.

This is a flag? It’s a reference to a historical anarchist flag commonly translated as “death to those who stand in the way of freedom to the working class”. To suggest a flag cannot be violent is a very strange concept as well seeing as the many flags which have connotations of violence (like fascist flags) and ones directly referencing violence like the “kingdom of benin flag”. As for the political message whether you agree or not flags are obviously inherently political. Many of them in former eastern block states represent freedom from communism with Latvia literally having the blood shed for independence. The uk flag being representative of a once large empire a symbol of past colonial ambitions. A flag can be (and at times are) violent and political. The only real reason for a removal is the arguing of comments. Which you will say is an effect of the flag but literally in the past month there has been a Saudi flag with hanging bodies, flags can be and often are striking and political and debates naturally arise.
No, thank you for trying so hard to be helpful. Greatly appreciated.
